verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is primarily a simple HTTP endpoint (r.jina.ai) usable via curl/headers rather than a documented multi-language official SDK; there's a GitHub repo, an MCP server, and header-based options, but no evidence of official Python/JS/etc SDK packages, and OpenAPI/spec discovery probes failed (404s), plus community reports of auth/401 issues suggest rough edges for programmatic integration.
